text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san, regarding your latest assignment—
there were a few noticeable minor mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: It's tough for skipping-grade students with so much to memorize, but let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! I'll make sure to do much better next time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Neither my races nor my schoolwork have been going well lately... Even though I have to produce good results...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Since I came all the way to Tracen Academy, I have to be more dependable and try even harder...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...What should I do to become more grown-up—?)
Guess who~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eek!? ...I-Is that voice... Sky-san...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... wasn't this time slot supposed to be for joint training...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mm~ I figured that could wait for next time~. Sei-chan's in more of a fishing mood right now~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, going alone is kinda boring though. If you're free, wanna keep me company for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Right now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm, mountain stream fishing really is the best, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... we haven't caught a single fish yet, will it be alright?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe it would be better to change our spot or bait to catch a big one—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, now, no need to rush. The waiting time is part of the charm of fishing, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If you stress out thinking "I've gotta catch a big one!", you'll just end up exhausted, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: When it's something you like, go at your own pace. You gotta enjoy doing it your own way♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-san...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (At my own pace... Could it be that I should too...?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! W-Wah, I got a bite...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, stay calm~. Pull the rod when I give the signal—okay, now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I caught one... Fufu. It's tiny and so cute...♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: See? It's fun even if it isn't a big one, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having had the chance to chat with Nishino Flower, whose race results and academics have both been on the rise recently, I asked her what the secret was—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, well... I'm just parroting someone else, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's to go at your own pace and enjoy doing things the way you want, desu♪
